item.title: Sacred Heart Church Hosting Free Community Meal Jan. 20
item.description: Sacred Heart Church's January community meal will be offered in the gymnasium at Sacred Heart Church, 125 N. Harrison St., Warsaw from 5-6:30 p.m., or until food runs out, on Tuesday, Jan. 20.

item.title: Bipartisan Bill To Improve IRS Services Advances
item.description: The bipartisan Barcode Automation for Revenue Collection to Organize Disbursement and Enhance Efficiency Act (H.R. 6956) passed out of the Ways and Means Committee on Thursday, Jan. 14.

item.title: Whitko Cancels After School Programs For Weather
item.description: Whitko Community Schools has cancelled all after school athletic events, games and meetings and any other after school activity due to weather conditions for Wednesday, Jan. 14.

item.title: Legislators Return To Longtime Debate Over Indiana Townships
item.description: Hundreds of Indiana township governments could be forced into consolidation under a renewed attempt in the Legislature for streamlining the 1,000-plus such bodies across the state.

item.title: Nathaniel Jon Bontrager
item.description: Infant Nathaniel Jon Bontrager died at 8:05 p.m. Tuesday, Jan. 13, 2026, at Memorial Hospital, South Bend. He was born at 5:12 a.m. Friday, Jan. 9, 2026, at home. item.title: KCCRVC Approves Grant For Kosciusko County Historical Society
item.description: The Kosciusko County Convention, Recreation and Visitors Commission approved an $8,600 grant for the Kosciusko County Historical Society to host several individuals from the Miami nation during the Kosciusko County Freedom Fest Celebration.

item.title: Wabash To Close Goshen Facility In March, Laying Off 144
item.description: Wabash National Services will permanently close its northern Indiana manufacturing facility on 2572 E. Kercher Rd., Goshen, resulting in the layoff of 144 workers, according to a notice filed with the Indiana Department of Workforce Development.

item.title: City of Warsaw Parks And Recreation Family Movie Night Happening This Friday
item.description: The City of Warsaw Parks and Recreation Department invites families to join them at the Warsaw Performing Arts Center at Warsaw Community High School for a special showing of “Frozen.”

item.title: Driver Retrieved From Rollover Crash Outside Milford
item.description: First responders retrieved a driver from the scene of roadside accident after their truck slid off the road and overturned 5:15 p.m. Wednesday, Jan. 14 near Milford.

item.title: IU Grad’s Startup Launches App To Help Quit Vaping
item.description: An Indiana University grad - and former vaping addict - has launched a new mobile application designed to help users monitor, reduce or quit vaping through data-driven tools and personalized plans.
